observed_incidents.observed: Called before collected state and received the same generic runtime_failure.
observed_incidents.classification: The requirement to collect before listing immutable outputs is reasonable; the diagnostic projection is inadequate.

root_cause_evidence: Configured CommandTCADExecutorAdapter operation_timeout_seconds is 30; SSH transport operation_timeout_seconds is 120.
ExecutionBridge.sync records terminal succeeded before adapter.collect and ingests results only after collect returns.
SSH collect downloads every descriptor serially and does not skip previously downloaded valid files before remote.get.
Empty stdout/stderr transport logs first appeared at 2026-09-13T04:01:54.383443Z. The installed command adapter creates this empty stderr record in its subprocess.TimeoutExpired handler.
A bounded installed-code synthetic timeout probe reproduced the original RuntimeError, chained TimeoutExpired(30), empty log records and loss of specific information in rpc_error.
The installed Root proxy has a 10-second default and two observed calls returned at approximately that duration. The actual proxy launch timeout was not independently recovered.
diagnostic_visibility_defects: rpc_error converts non-DiagnosticError exceptions into a generic runtime_failure with no cause or concrete error reference.
The proxy uses the same conversion for its own errors.
Command timeout preservation can retain only empty child stdout/stderr while the useful timeout exception remains outside those logs.
No matching scidiscovery-control journal entries were returned for the incident interval.
status_of_fix: No production source, deployment configuration, VM file or scientific object was edited.

proposed_bounded_recovery.action: Raise only the existing command-adapter operation_timeout_seconds from 30 to 300, restart the control service, and synchronize the SAME approved execution to collect its existing results.
proposed_bounded_recovery.limits: This is a bounded recovery configuration, not a complete fix for synchronous collection or diagnostic projection.
